授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
This course aims to develop students’ ability to analyse, compare, and discuss Japanese current affairs using English. Students will examine how issues in Japan are represented in both domestic and international media, and will build the skills necessary to think critically.
The course will be conducted solely in English.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Students are expected to acquire "international communication skills" (C-1-2.), which are the foundation for learning in the ISI, and be able to explain the details of solutions to a particular issue to people around the world and gain their understanding and cooperation.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Discussion, current affairs, critical thinking, media analysis, intercultural communication
